summary: Iteration 9 — full coverage of 4 new features (LLM settings UI, AI generate-description, OG share /api/share/{id}, resume-where-you-left-off) plus MediaSession integration. Backend: 15/15 new pytest cases in test_iter9_features.py PASS (settings GET/PATCH partial+empty-key-preserves+clear_api_key+enabled toggle, test_llm returns ok:false with reachable error message, generate_description returns 502 on unreachable LLM and 404 on bad mix id and 401 unauth, /api/share/{id} returns text/html with og:title+og:description+og:image+og:url+twitter:card+twitter:image+meta http-equiv refresh, ?t=120 propagates to og:url and refresh URL, fallback to favicon when no cover). Full pytest regression: 85 passed + 8 skipped (Redis only) in 14.4s across 7 test files. Frontend e2e: link-admin-settings present on AdminDashboard top bar, navigation to /admin/settings works, all 8 required data-testids present (admin-settings-page, llm-settings-section, llm-base-url-input, llm-model-input, llm-api-key-input, llm-enabled-toggle, save-settings-button, test-llm-button), SAVE persists across reload (UI_TEST_MODEL_777 round-trips), TEST CONNECTION shows 'UNREACHABLE — Cannot reach http://localhost:30000/v1/models: All connection attempts failed' in [data-testid=llm-test-result]. AI GENERATE button [data-testid=generate-description-button] present in MixEditModal and clicking it shows 'AI GENERATION FAILED' toast (LLM unreachable as expected). Share button copies https://dj-cue-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api/share/{mix_id} to clipboard. Resume banner appears after planting localStorage['mixdeck_resume']={mixId:{t:1934,...}}, banner text shows '32:14' formatted time, [data-testid=resume-button] + [data-testid=dismiss-resume] present, dismiss removes banner AND clears the localStorage entry for that mix. MediaSession verified while playing: navigator.mediaSession.metadata.title='Intro', .artist='WF Tester', .album='WF SAMPLE', .playbackState='playing'. Zero console errors, zero page errors.

issues: navigator.mediaSession.metadata.artwork array is empty (length=0) while playing WF SAMPLE which DOES have a cover image visible in the UI. Lock-screen and Bluetooth car displays will show no artwork. Likely cause: PlayerContext is not populating the `artwork` field of MediaMetadata (should be e.g. [{src:`${BASE_URL}/api/cover/${mix.id}`, sizes:'512x512', type:'image/jpeg'}]). Title/artist/album/playbackState are correctly set so this is the only gap.

action_items: (LOW priority) PlayerContext.jsx: when setting navigator.mediaSession.metadata, also populate artwork array using the mix's coverUrl (`${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/cover/${mix.id}` when cover_filename or source_cover_path exists, else cover_url). Currently artwork=[] so lock-screen/CarPlay/Bluetooth displays show no album art.
critical_code_review_comments: settings_service.update_settings has a subtle precedence bug-shape on line 59: `if v == '' or v is None and patch.get('clear_api_key') is not True` — Python operator precedence makes this parse as `v == '' or (v is None and patch.get('clear_api_key') is not True)`, which by accident gives the intended behaviour (empty-string preserves; None+no-clear preserves) but is fragile. Suggest rewriting as `if v in ('', None) and patch.get('clear_api_key') is not True: continue` for clarity. Tests already cover the happy paths so no functional regression now.

llm_service._post raises LLMError on httpx.HTTPError but llm_service.health_check catches httpx.HTTPError directly and returns dict — inconsistent. Acceptable since they have different semantics (test_llm shouldn't 502 the request) but worth a docstring note.

/api/share/{id} renders inline HTML via f-string. Title/artist/desc are passed through xml_escape so XSS-safe, but cover URL is NOT escaped on line 668 (`{e(cover)}` IS escaped — checked, it is fine). Confirmed safe.
Frontend: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is hard-burned into the share URL clipboard copy — correct. No hardcoded localhost.
MixEditModal generate-description-button: error path uses toast and surfaces the 502 detail string from the backend — clean UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (15/15 UI assertions; 1 minor design note on missing artwork in MediaSession)

App `settings` doc was modified during testing (final state: llm_model='UI_TEST_MODEL_777' or last test value, llm_base_url='http://localhost:30000/v1', llm_enabled=true, llm_api_key cleared). Main agent should be aware that the settings doc was touched — if a clean default state is needed, PATCH /api/admin/settings with desired values.

Settings doc lives in mongo collection `settings` with id='app' — see /app/backend/settings_service.py.
